en.title: Preliminary Observation: Possible Wetland Loss at Site A
en.summary: A 1.42 ha area within the Wetland Buffer Area shows a persistent transition from water-covered to dry surface.
evidence: Radar backscatter rose 5.9 dB above baseline
First detected 2025-04, persistent in 5 of 6 recent months

statutory_basis.claim: Developments within the Wetland Buffer Area are subject to assessment requirements under Town Planning Board guidelines.

en.recommended_action: Refer for site inspection and zoning confirmation by the relevant authority.
en.limitations: Satellite-derived indicator for screening purposes only. This is not a legal determination of unauthorised development. Findings require site verification by the relevant authority.

zh_hant.title: 初步觀察：A 地點可能出現濕地損失
zh_hant.summary: 位於濕地緩衝區內一片 1.42 公頃的土地顯示出由水體覆蓋轉變為乾燥表面的持續變化。
evidence: 雷達後向散射較基準上升 5.9 dB
首次發現於 2025-04，在最近 6 個月中持續 5 個月

statutory_basis.claim: 濕地緩衝區內的發展須根據相關城市規劃委員會指引進行評估要求。

zh_hant.recommended_action: 轉交主管部門進行實地核實及規劃用途確認。
zh_hant.limitations: 本結果為衛星遙感篩查指標，僅供參考，並非對違例發展的法律認定。相關發現須由主管部門進行實地核實。

citations.quote: Application for developments within the Deep Bay Area under Section 16 of the Town Planning Ordinance.
